Source: https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss.com/blob/main/src/blog/tailwindcss-2-1/index.mdx

Command to upgrade Tailwind CSS to the latest version.

```bash
npm install tailwindcss@latest
```

--------------------------------

### 1. Install Tailwind CSS

Source: https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss.com/blob/main/src/blog/tailwindcss-v4/index.mdx

Command to install Tailwind CSS v4.0 and its PostCSS plugin.

```shell
npm i tailwindcss @tailwindcss/postcss;
```

--------------------------------

### Install Tailwind CSS v3.0

Source: https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss.com/blob/main/src/blog/tailwindcss-v3/index.mdx

Command to install Tailwind CSS v3.0 along with PostCSS and Autoprefixer.

```sh
npm install -D tailwindcss@latest postcss autoprefixer
```

--------------------------------

### Standard Tailwind CSS directives

Source: https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss.com/blob/main/src/blog/tailwindcss-1-6/index.mdx

The typical @tailwind directives found in a custom input CSS file.

```css
@tailwind base;
@tailwind components;
@tailwind utilities;
```

--------------------------------

### Importing Tailwind CSS

Source: https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss.com/blob/main/src/blog/tailwindcss-v4-alpha/index.mdx

How to import Tailwind CSS into your project using a regular CSS `@import` statement.

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
```

npm install tailwindcss@latest

### 1. Install Tailwind CSS

Source: https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss.com/blob/main/src/blog/tailwindcss-v4/index.mdx

Command to install Tailwind CSS v4.0 and its PostCSS plugin.

```shell
npm i tailwindcss @tailwindcss/postcss;
```

Source: https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss.com/blob/main/src/blog/tailwindcss-v3/index.mdx

Command to install Tailwind CSS v3.0 along with PostCSS and Autoprefixer.

```sh
npm install -D tailwindcss@latest postcss autoprefixer
```

--------------------------------

### Standard Tailwind CSS directives

Source: https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss.com/blob/main/src/blog/tailwindcss-1-6/index.mdx

The typical @tailwind directives found in a custom input CSS file.

```css
@tailwind base;
@tailwind components;
@tailwind utilities;
```

--------------------------------

### Importing Tailwind CSS

Source: https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss.com/blob/main/src/blog/tailwindcss-v4-alpha/index.mdx

How to import Tailwind CSS into your project using a regular CSS `@import` statement.

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
```
